proposals.evidence: DEDR3715 explicitly gives Kannada noṇa/noṇavu fly/housefly. Survey none is the corresponding nominal response, with its final vowel and source dental/lateral convention retained. The nearby nonga-type forms are not assumed to belong to this stem. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Survey uḷa represents the weak-initial worm noun, comparable with Kannada huḷa; preserve its initial consonant loss and original form rather than silently normalizing it. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4735 gives Kannada malagu/malaṅgu recline/lie down and Tulu malaguni sleep. Survey malugu is the ordinary same-language sleep verb with unstressed vowel variation, not a compound or a borrowed nidra noun. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1097 gives Kannada kaccu bite and Tamil kaccu gnaw/nibble. Survey kacc-/kats-/kac- bite responses are comparative southern variants retaining the source affricate spelling and ordinary final vowels; the semantic fit is explicitly biting. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
